effects: The signer receives exactly _amount of the epoch's airdrop token from the airdrop contract. The token is read from storage (merkleRoots[_epoch].token); when it is the zero address, native ETH is sent instead.
The signer's claim for _epoch is marked as used, so it cannot be claimed again. No asset leaves the signer, and the function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Claim 225 for epoch 0", with a raw amount in smallest units, the epoch, and the proof hidden. The token is never named.

findings.title: claim: the token received is read from storage per epoch, so the screen cannot name it
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol _claim: `Dist memory distribution = merkleRoots[_epoch]; ... SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(distribution.token), msg.sender, _amount)`, or a native `call{value: _amount}` when the token is address(0). The token is set by submitRoot/updateToken and is not in calldata. In case 0 the signer received 225 uniBTC (0x004e9c3e..., 8 decimals), and the screen names no token.
findings.fix: Nothing in the calldata carries the token. If every epoch is guaranteed to pay uniBTC, a tokenAmount with a constant token could be used. Otherwise keep it raw and say in the intent which token the program pays.

findings.title: claim: interpolatedIntent 'Claim 225' reads as 225 whole tokens, but it is 225 base units
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Claim {_amount} for epoch {_epoch}" with `_amount` in format raw. Case 0 shows "Claim 225 for epoch 0", while the real transfer was 225 satoshi-units of uniBTC (0.00000225 uniBTC). Only the field label says "(smallest unit)".
findings.fix: Change the wording to "Claim {_amount} base units of the airdrop token for epoch {_epoch}". If the token is fixed, use tokenAmount or unit with decimals 8.

findings.title: claim: contractName says suniBTC airdrop, but the mined claim paid uniBTC
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.contractName "Bedrock suniBTC Airdrop (Selini)". The case 0 mined effect is a transfer of asset 0x004e9c3ef86bc1ca1f0bb5c7662861ee93350568, symbol uniBTC.
findings.fix: Use a name that matches the token paid, or say that the airdrop goes to suniBTC holders and pays out in uniBTC.

cases.notes: The signer received 225 uniBTC (8 decimals). The screen shows the raw amount 225 and epoch 0 but no token, so the reader got the direction and the amount but not the asset.
